learning_outcomes.text: Students possess an overview of the most important processes and materials used in industrial production to plan basic manufacturing processes regarding required quality characteristics and target costs.
They can predict and evaluate the quality characteristics of manufactured parts by understanding the process-specific error technologies.
Through the acquired knowledge of cost accounting, they are able to perform economic analyses when selecting manufacturing processes and designing process chains.
They can define the necessary production tools and machines based on the learned, simplifying calculation approaches regarding strength, force and power requirements, and service life.
With the learned knowledge, they can perform force calculations for forming, machining, and casting processes, interpret process flows, and master methods for analyzing corresponding process times.
Students critically engage with and evaluate various manufacturing processes and their specifics.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturing technology within production technology, Classification of manufacturing processes
The four basic criteria of manufacturing technology: Main technology, Error technology, Economic efficiency, Human-environment technology

Primary forming technology: Manufacturing process in a foundry, Casting materials, Formation of the solidification microstructure, Casting processes with expendable molds, Casting processes with permanent molds, Additive manufacturing processes
Forming technology: Classification of forming processes, Division of total forming into stages, Forming machines, Fundamentals of plasticity theory and metallurgy, Various forming processes

Machining technology: Classification of processes, Machining process, Characteristic values of chip-forming, Technologies for machining with geometrically defined and geometrically undefined cutting edges
Further aspects of manufacturing technology: Automation, Sustainability, Energy efficiency, Economic efficiency
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance will be determined by the lecturers: written exam or oral exam.
